item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Change Only the Bottle

turns.text: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.

item.tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

answer_sheet.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
answer_sheet.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.

turns.text: Could you make a small color change to the bottle in this pic? I’m trying to picture how a different color would feel before I decide whether I like it. The bottle is black right now, and I want just that bottle turned forest green, keeping it matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow. I’m a little worried that changing the color might make the whole picture feel different, which is why I’m spelling this out.
turns.agent:
The edit couldn’t run because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created or changed.

Once credits are available, I can retry the matte forest-green recolor. For your requirement that everything outside the bottle stay **exactly identical**, a masked color adjustment in a photo editor is more reliable than generative editing, which may slightly alter surrounding pixels.

approvals.name: edit_image

args.name: Matte forest green bottle — color only

style.prompt: Make a strictly localized color-only edit to the existing black water bottle: recolor the entire bottle including its cap and carry loop to a deep natural forest green (approximately #234B35), keeping its finish matte. Preserve the exact bottle silhouette, dimensions, position, cap details, existing texture, highlights, and original light-to-dark shading. This is a product color preview, not a restyling. Everything outside the bottle must remain exactly unchanged: preserve the wooden table and its grain, the bottle's cast shadow and contact shadow, background, chairs, plant, windows, walls, depth of field, lighting, white balance, exposure, composition and framing. Do not add green reflections or a green color cast to any surroundings. Do not relight, enhance, regenerate, move, or alter any other part of the image.
